summary: Focana 2.4.11 keeps paused and break-time compact surfaces calm, readable, and correctly sized.
improvements: Paused compact, compact break-prompt, and active break-timer states now have dedicated background regression coverage.
fixes: The 90-minute break prompt now stacks below the compact pill instead of squeezing the task into a narrow column.
Paused compact and active break-timer handoffs now keep their controls and timer fully inside the window.
